GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (1 Mar 46) GC
(SCAPIN - 782)
APO 500
1 March 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Japanese Diplomats.
1. The Japanese repatriation vessel NATSUZUKI is scheduled to arrive at Yokohama on or about 15 March 1946. This vessel transports 300 to 400 Japanese diplomats transported from Europe to Manila aboard the Plus Ultra.
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will be prepared to receive these repatriated diplomatic and consular personnel.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
